reports.title: Tetra Tech Reports Strong Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: Tetra Tech expects EPS for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 to range from $0.36 to $0.38 and net revenue2 to range from $1.04 billion to $1.08 billion. For fiscal year 2027, Tetra Tech expects EPS to range from $1.65 to $1.80, and net revenue to range from $4.425 billion to $4.625 billion.
